lawyer:
Mr. A.B.M. Nurul Islam, Senior Advocate, instructed by Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record, For the Petitioner
Respondent: Not represented
parties:
Md. Shafique Miah ---- Accused-Petitioner
Vs.
The State ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 2. Relevant Facts are as follows. On 19.8.93 a sub-inspector of police Chunarghat P.S. made G.D. entry No. 658 to the effect that one Maina Mia (victim), a notorious cattle lifter and a habitual thief in the early hour of the day was caught and beaten by the local angry mass. The present petitioner Md. Shafique Miah as Chairman of the local Union Parishad informed the incident to the local Police Station and thereafter the police arrested Maina Mia under Section 54 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, Maina Mia was also an accused in some other cases. On 23.8.93. Most. Shafiqun Nessa, wife of Moina Mia lodged a petition of complaint before the Magistrate, First Class, Chunarghat under Sections 144/148/323/307/34 P.C stating, inter alia, that on the order of the petitioner other local people had assaulted her said husband and then police took him to the hospital. Subsequently said Mani Mia died in the hospital while he had been under police custody. The police after investigation submitted final report on 18.8.94. On 24.8.94 one Mallika Banu wife of Yunus Ali, filed an application against the said final report and prayed for further investigation into the case. On 2.10.94 the concerned Magistrate allowed the said application and directed holding of judicial enquiry into the matter by Mr. Manik Lal Banik, Magistrate 2nd Class Habiganj. Thereafter the petitioner moved the learned Sessions Judge, Habiganj for setting aside the aforesaid order of the Magistrate stating inter alia that the concerned Magistrate had acted illegally in passing the order for holding further investigation upon an application filed by a third party. But ultimately the same was rejected on 3.7.95 by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Habiganj. The petitioner then moved the High Court Division under Section 561A Cr.P.C. against the said order of the learned Additional Sessions Judge and obtained a Rule, which has been discharged by the impugned judgment and order.
